_comment: DUNGEON RUN companions. Max 2 at a time. They do not fight and cannot be killed. Each one reshapes the whole run. Sacrifice is always available, always permanent.

companions.name: Grave-Tender Mol
companions.flavor: She was burying the dungeon's dead long before you arrived. She has opinions about how it should be done.

passive.text: All your summons enter with +4 HP and +2 attack.

sacrifice.name: Open the Graves
sacrifice.text: Heal to full. Immediately raise every enemy that has died this fight.

companions.name: Ashlin the Ember
companions.flavor: Chained next to a torch for so long she started to become one. Freeing her was arguably a mistake.

companions.name: The Pale Debtor
companions.flavor: He does not say what he is owed, or by whom. He only follows, and keeps count.

passive.text: Whenever you lose HP from your OWN cards, heal 3 and deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.

sacrifice.name: Settle the Debt
sacrifice.text: Remove all curses from your deck. Heal to full.

companions._comment: From the Portal Ruins event only (eventOnly): never an elite's prisoner or the Chained Prisoner.
companions.name: The Mysterious King
companions.flavor: He stepped out of the portal wearing a crown no one has ever seen. He says he is the king of this place. The dungeon does not argue.

passive.text: Every enemy starts each fight Weak 1: it deals 25% less damage on its first turn.

sacrifice.name: Royal Decree
sacrifice.text: Every enemy loses half its current HP.
